From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>

Cc: Finance Ops <finance-ops@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Dec 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: SF holdlist triage — please claim stale deals

Team — finance needs a clean commit snapshot by EOD Tuesday for the mid-month forecast. I pulled a short "holdlist" of opportunities that either have stale close dates (90+ days since last update) or are in a near-close stage with no recent activity. Please do the following by EOD today (end of your local day):

- Mark yourself owner/claim an opportunity you are actively pursuing OR
- Update Close Date and Stage if there is agreement with the customer OR
- Mark as Nurture/Archive if we have no active next step (include rationale)

Quick context: we want to avoid over-committing revenue that won’t materialize and give finance a defensible snapshot. I attached the CSV (holdlist_snapshot_20261206.csv) with SF IDs and last touch. Sample rows below: 

- ACME-5721 | Acme Corp | $320k | Stage: Contract | Close Date: 2026-07-15 | Last Activity: 2026-08-02 | AE: unassigned
- SH-8832 | StellarHealth | $95k | Stage: Proposal | Close Date: 2026-09-01 | Last Activity: 2026-09-10 | AE: lauren.bishop
- ACME-6042 | Acme Corp | $42k | Stage: Negotiation | Close Date: 2026-05-20 | Last Activity: 2026-05-20 | AE: unassigned

Please reply-all with your claim and the action you took (one-line is fine). If you need me to coordinate a short customer touch, note that in your reply and I'll assist. Finance will take the snapshot at 16:00 PT once we have acked owners.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

I can also take ACME-6042 back into a nurture cadence — the buyer went dark; propose we move to 90-day nurture and archive from commit. @Ben — can you cover ACME-5721? It looks like it needs a legal/SOW touch.

- SH-8832 (StellarHealth) — claimed by Lauren; update: Proposal -> Proposal - Active; new close date 2026-12-20.
- ACME-5721 (Acme Corp) — claimed by Ben; status: Contract with "Need SOW meeting" next step; please do not force-close for now.
- ACME-6042 (Acme Corp) — recommended archive/nurture by Lauren (90-day nurture).

Action items:
- @Finance Ops: please take the commit snapshot at 16:00 PT and exclude opportunities marked Nurture/Archive.
- @Ben: please ping Alice Rivera and push for a SOW meeting; mark in SF when scheduled.
- @Lauren: attach your procurement notes to SH-8832.
- @Rishi: please help monitor any downstream bookings for ACME if Ben requests legal escalation.
